ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Memory Dumping Activity Via LiveKD
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of LiveKD based on PE metadata or image name

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd64\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "livekd\.exe")
